The '''Galactic Courts''' was a series of courts that were created by the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances]]. They were charged with watching for government abuse and corruption. Even though the courts were not particularly speedy, The Courts proved much more effective than those of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Old Republic]] and [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]].<ref name="Legacy Era" />

The highest of the Galactic Courts was the [[Court of Justice|Supreme Court]], with its twelve members appointed by the [[Triumvirate (Galactic Alliance)|Triumvirate]] and confirmed by the [[Galactic Alliance Senate|Galactic Senate]].<ref name="Legacy Era" />

Under the [[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire]], the Courts remained intact for criminal prosecutions and civil mediation, but were stripped of their powers to oversee the government.<ref name="Legacy Era" />
